protocol: Chronological 60/20/20; architecture selected by validation MAE, then refit train+validation. Rolling one-day forecasts: observed earlier test days are available for subsequent predictions. No target-day weather, casual/registered counts or future demand.
limits: 731 historical days from one system (2011–2012). Small CPU MLP; no multi-day fixed-origin guarantee, production deployment or causal claim. Neural model is published as an experiment even if Ridge wins validation.
